formats.key: deployVault(uint256 initialDeposit, uint256 maxManagementFee, uint256 maxPerformanceFee)
effects: Pulls initialDeposit USDC from the signer to the deployer, using an allowance the signer gave earlier (safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), initialDeposit)).
Deposits that USDC into the newly cloned PlasmaVault and mints the vault shares (teUSDC) to the signer (deposit(initialDeposit, msg.sender)).
Grants the signer WHITELIST_ROLE on the new vault.
Control of the new vault goes to parties Tesseract stored in the deployer, not to the signer: vaultOwner gets OWNER_ROLE, plus the atomist, guardian, alpha, fuseManager and rewards manager.
Sets the vault's management and performance fees from storage, paid to the stored feeRecipient. The call reverts if either fee is above the signer's maxManagementFee or maxPerformanceFee.
Reverts if initialDeposit is below the stored minInitialDeposit.
formats.shown: "Deploy Vault" with the share ticker teUSDC, the initial deposit in USDC, and the maximum management and performance fees as percentages.

findings.title: deployVault intent 'Deploy Vault' leaves out the USDC deposit and the shares the signer receives.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Deploy Vault", interpolatedIntent absent. TesseractVaultDeployer._deployVault: safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, ..., initialDeposit) and PlasmaVault.deposit(initialDeposit, msg.sender). Case 0: 50 USDC out, 5000000000 teUSDC in to the signer.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Deploy teUSDC vault and deposit {initialDeposit}", and an intent like "Deploy vault and deposit USDC".

findings.title: deployVault screen never says vault shares are minted to the signer; it only shows a share ticker.
findings.evidence: Case 0 mined: teUSDC 5000000000 from 0x0 to the signer (signer: in). The screen only has 'Vault share ticker: teUSDC', and the reader wrote 'amount not shown; presumably to my wallet'.
findings.fix: Relabel the ticker field as something like 'You receive shares of' or 'Shares received (teUSDC)', or say it in the interpolated intent.

findings.title: deployVault 'Deploy Vault' suggests the signer owns the vault, but Tesseract-set addresses get all admin roles.
findings.evidence: _deployVault: grantRole(OWNER_ROLE, vaultOwner), grantRole(ATOMIST_ROLE, atomist), GUARDIAN_ROLE to guardian, etc. The signer only gets WHITELIST_ROLE. Case 0 reader: 'A new vault is created, likely with me as its owner or manager'.
findings.fix: Use an intent such as "Deploy Tesseract-managed vault", or add a constant field noting that Tesseract manages the vault.

findings.title: deployVault: actual fee rates, fee recipient and vault managers are read from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: _deployVault reads managementFee, performanceFee and feeRecipient (updateManagementFee/updatePerformanceFee), plus vaultOwner, atomist, guardian and alpha, from storage. The screen shows only the signer's maximums.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The max-fee fields already bound the fees.

cases.notes: The 50 USDC out is shown with the right token and amount. The teUSDC shares in are only hinted by the ticker field: no amount, and it never says they go to the signer. The reader inferred the shares but not their amount.

formats.key: deployVaultWithPermit(uint256 initialDeposit, uint256 maxManagementFee, uint256 maxPerformanceFee, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Uses the signer's EIP-2612 permit to set the deployer's USDC allowance to initialDeposit (valid until deadline). If the permit fails, it falls back to an existing allowance of at least initialDeposit.
Pulls initialDeposit USDC from the signer to the deployer, which spends that allowance.
Deposits that USDC into the new PlasmaVault and mints the vault shares (teUSDC) to the signer.
Grants the signer WHITELIST_ROLE on the new vault.
Admin roles on the vault go to Tesseract-configured addresses (vaultOwner, atomist, guardian, alpha, fuseManager, rewards manager), not to the signer.
Sets the vault fees from storage, paid to the stored feeRecipient. Reverts if they are above the signer's maximums or if initialDeposit is below minInitialDeposit.
formats.shown: "Deploy Vault (Permit)" with the share ticker, the initial deposit in USDC, the maximum fees as percentages, and the permit deadline as a date.

findings.title: deployVaultWithPermit intent says 'Deploy Vault (Permit)' but not that USDC is deposited and shares are received.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Deploy Vault (Permit)", interpolatedIntent absent. deployVaultWithPermit calls permit(msg.sender, address(this), initialDeposit, ...) and then _deployVault, which pulls initialDeposit and deposits it for msg.sender.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Deploy teUSDC vault and deposit {initialDeposit}". Replace the jargon '(Permit)' with something like 'using a signed approval'.

findings.title: deployVaultWithPermit shows a share ticker but never says shares are minted to the signer.
findings.evidence: _deployVault: PlasmaVault(...).deposit(initialDeposit, msg.sender). The only related field is 'Vault share ticker' (raw constant teUSDC).
findings.fix: Relabel the field as something like 'Shares received (teUSDC)', or put it in the interpolated intent.

findings.title: deployVaultWithPermit intent suggests the signer gets a vault they control; Tesseract addresses get the admin roles.
findings.evidence: _deployVault grants OWNER_ROLE to vaultOwner and ATOMIST_ROLE to atomist. The signer only gets WHITELIST_ROLE.
findings.fix: Use an intent such as "Deploy Tesseract-managed vault".

findings.title: deployVaultWithPermit: actual fees, fee recipient and vault roles come from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: _deployVault reads managementFee, performanceFee, feeRecipient, vaultOwner, atomist and guardian from storage.
